The '''Strategic Insertion battalion''' was a special, lethal, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] organization used for infiltration and deployment against hostile targets without them knowing to gain the element of surprise. In this way they were similar to [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm Commandos]] but would actually operate out of uniform, unusual for stormtroopers.
